boxes.title: Donors: added detail
head: Donor
Added fact
rows: Aunt of Virapurushadatta; stone mandapa at ==**Ghantasala**==; Mahavihara for **Bhadanta Ananda**
Pillar for both birth and marital families
Sister of **Ehuvala**; great stupa too; married ==**Vishnurudra Sivalananda Satakarni**== (Chutus)
Kin of treasurer **Bodhisarma**; viharas for foreign monks

boxes.title: Inscriptions & titles
items: Each names the donor by her tie to the king
Chamtisri prays for his ==**long life, victory, prosperity**==

cards.title: Trade
lines: Romans built a stadium under Sri Santamula

boxes.title: Society: more
items: Women's general status ==declined==; royal women kept agency
Shift: Satavahana trade economy → **agrarian, agrahara-based** order
